title: Catalog
description: Every list of kinds in the game. Kinds are data: code reads their properties, never their names.

Id.description: Stable identifier of a kind, stored in the database: never renamed or reused.

Art.description: Paths of a kind's art files, relative to the repository's art/ folder.

description.description: What the boat is, in a few words.

capacity.description: Most people aboard, the skipper included.

BoatPhysics.title: BoatPhysics
BoatPhysics.description: The boat's physics, in SI units with angles in degrees. Every value is required.

PhysicsHull.title: PhysicsHull
PhysicsHull.description: The hull: its mass, resistance, inertia and stability.

displacement.description: Boat, rig and sailor, in kg.

waterlineLength.description: Length on the waterline, in m.

hullDraught.description: The hull's own draught, foils aside, in m.

centreOfGravity.description: Height of the centre of gravity above the waterline, in m.

dragAreaStep.description: Speed between entries of dragArea, in m/s.

dragArea.description: Upright resistance as a drag area (C_D A), at speeds 0, 1, 2 … times dragAreaStep, in m². Beyond the last, the last.

crossFlowDrag.description: Drag coefficient of the hull moving sideways, on waterline length times draught.

addedMassSurge.description: Added mass moving ahead, in kg.

addedMassSway.description: Added mass moving sideways, hull and foils, in kg.

munk.description: The hull's added mass sideways less its added mass ahead, for the Munk moment, in kg.

yawInertia.description: Moment of inertia in yaw, added inertia included, in kg·m².

rollInertia.description: Moment of inertia in roll, added inertia included, in kg·m².

rollDamping.description: The hull's own roll damping, in N·m·s/rad. The foils and sails damp through their flow.

rightingLever.description: Righting lever (GZ) with the sailor on the centreline, every 10° of heel from 0° to 180°, in m.

luff.description: Length of the luff, in m.

foot.description: Length of the foot, in m.

boomHeight.description: Height of the boom above the waterline, in m.

mastPosition.description: Distance of the mast ahead of the centre of gravity, in m.

footStrip.description: Height of the lower sail strip's centre of effort above the boom, as a fraction of the luff.

headStrip.description: Height of the upper sail strip's centre of effort above the boom, as a fraction of the luff.

pressureAttached.description: Centre of pressure aft of the mast with the flow attached, as a fraction of the foot.

pressureSeparated.description: Centre of pressure aft of the mast with the flow separated, as a fraction of the foot.

effectiveHeight.description: Effective rig height for induced drag, in m.

quadraticDrag.description: Drag growing with the square of the lift coefficient (k_pm).

maxLift.description: Greatest lift coefficient of the sail.

stallAngle.description: Angle of attack of the greatest lift, in degrees.

stallWidth.description: Angle past the stall over which the flow separates, in degrees.

sailDrag.description: Viscous drag coefficient of the sail.

luffAngle.description: Below this angle of attack the cloth flogs, in degrees.

flogDrag.description: Extra drag coefficient of flogging cloth.

normalForce.description: Normal force coefficient of separated flow over the sail, every 10° of angle of attack from 0° to 180°.

twistPowered.description: The upper strip's twist beyond the boom at full power, in degrees.

twistDepowered.description: The upper strip's twist at the flattest, in degrees.

twistEased.description: Extra twist with the boom let fly, growing in proportion to the boom's angle, in degrees. On a dinghy whose sheet also holds the boom down, easing it lets the leech open.

twistTurn.description: Boom angle over which the twist turns from one side to the other, in degrees.

headBacked.description: The upper sail strip's angle of attack at which the wind starts to get behind its leech, in degrees. A backed head swings across and its leech drags the boom over: an accidental gybe.

headBackedWidth.description: Angle of attack over which a backed head comes to drag the boom across, in degrees.

boomIn.description: The boom's angle off the centreline with the sheet hauled in hard, in degrees.

boomOut.description: The boom's angle with the sheet let fly, in degrees.

boomInertia.description: Moment of inertia of boom and sail about the mast, in kg·m².

boomMoment.description: Mass of boom and sail times the distance of their centre of gravity aft of the mast, in kg·m.

boomDamping.description: Friction of the boom about the mast, in N·m·s/rad.

windageFront.description: Drag area of hull, crew and spars from ahead, in m².

windageSide.description: Drag area of hull, crew and spars from abeam, in m².

windageHeight.description: Height of the windage's centre above the waterline, in m.

sailFloat.description: Upward force per metre a sail strip is pushed under the water, in N/m.

sailWaterDamping.description: Vertical damping of a sail strip in the water, in N·s/m.

PhysicsFoils.title: PhysicsFoils
PhysicsFoils.description: The daggerboard or keel, and the rudder.

boardSpan.description: Span of the daggerboard below the hull, in m.

boardChord.description: Chord of the daggerboard, in m.

boardPosition.description: Distance of the daggerboard ahead of the centre of gravity, in m.

rudderSpan.description: Span of the rudder below the hull, in m.

rudderChord.description: Chord of the rudder, in m.

rudderPosition.description: Distance of the rudder aft of the centre of gravity, in m.

foilStall.description: Angle of attack at which the foils stall, in degrees.

foilStallWidth.description: Angle past the stall over which their flow separates, in degrees.

foilDrag.description: Viscous drag coefficient of the foils, on plan area.

plateNormal.description: Normal force coefficient of a stalled foil.

pressureDepth.description: Depth of each foil's centre of pressure below the hull, as a fraction of its span.

carryOver.description: The hull's carry-over of the board's lift: k in 1 + k × hull draught / board span.

heelLoss.description: The board's lift lost per radian of heel.

rudderInflow.description: The rudder's share of the boat's speed through the water.

downwash.description: Share of the sideways flow from leeway that the daggerboard's downwash cancels at the rudder.

foilWetHeel.description: Heel up to which the foils are fully in the water, in degrees.

foilDryHeel.description: Heel from which the foils are out of the water, in degrees.

PhysicsSailor.title: PhysicsSailor
PhysicsSailor.description: What the sailor does by themselves: hiking, flattening the sail, righting the boat. The same for every player.

sailorMass.description: Mass of the sailor, in kg.

sailorSeatHeight.description: Height of the seated sailor's centre of gravity above the boat's, in m.

hikeReach.description: Furthest the sailor's centre of gravity goes out to windward, in m.

leeReach.description: Furthest it goes to leeward, in m.

hikeSpeed.description: Fastest the sailor moves across, in m/s.

hikeLag.description: The sailor's lag in moving, in s.

heelGain.description: Extra hiking per radian of heel, in m/rad.

rollRateGain.description: Extra hiking per rad/s of roll rate, in m·s/rad.

flattenFrom.description: Apparent wind at which the sailor starts flattening the sail, in m/s.

flattenTo.description: Apparent wind at which the sail is at its flattest, in m/s.

flattenMin.description: Flattest sail, as a fraction of full lift.

fallOutHeel.description: Heel past which the sailor falls in, in degrees.

climbInHeel.description: Heel below which the sailor climbs back in, in degrees.

boardReach.description: Distance of the sailor's weight on the daggerboard from the centre of gravity, in m.

sailorDrag.description: Roll damping of the sailor in the water, holding on to the boat, in N·m·s/rad.

swimTime.description: Time to swim to the daggerboard after falling in, in s.

climbTime.description: Time to climb back in, in s.

PhysicsRates.title: PhysicsRates
PhysicsRates.description: How fast the sailor's hands move the rudder and the sheet.

rudderTime.description: Time for the rudder's full travel, one side to the other, in s.

sheetHaulTime.description: Time to haul the sheet in over its full range, in s.

sheetEaseTime.description: Time to ease the sheet out over its full range, in s.
